meta.title: Madar — the operating system for your tutoring center
meta.description: Madar runs your tutoring center end to end — reception, check-in, attendance, payments, teacher settlements and reports, all in one place.

cta.primary: Start now at the founding price

hero.kicker: The operating system for your center
hero.sub: Know what is happening in real time, and run attendance, collections, sessions and reception from one place — without paper, crowds or queues.
hero.assure: The complete Madar subscription is {{price}} EGP/month — no credit card needed
hero.visualCaption: The same lobby screen you use inside Madar

problem.title: You do not need more work. You need to know what is happening.
problem.sub: Today, answering any question about the center means finding someone to ask: the receptionist, the accountant, or the teacher themselves. And every answer comes from memory, not from a system.
problem.seeTitle: Madar shows you the answer from the system itself:
questions: How many students are in the center right now?
Who paid, and how much was collected?
What did the shift close at?
answers: A complete attendance record per session, in real time.
A live headcount per session, visible from the lobby.
Every payment recorded with its method and reference.
Settlements computed from real headcount, not guesswork.
Any gap between expected and counted cash shows up instantly.

visibility.title: From the lobby, you see the whole center running.
visibility.sub: The lobby is not just a screen — it is the first thing you open every day. It tells you what is running now and what is coming next, without walking around to ask anyone.
